entities.name: Kaalia of the Vast
entities.description: Cleric whose congregation was massacred by shadowy beings; she now amasses power for revenge.

entities.name: Tariel, Reckoner of Souls
entities.description: Being who rewoves souls into history; some texts tell of her banishment from an empyreal Host.

entities.name: Basandra, Battle Seraph
entities.description: Seraph revered by warriors who seek truth through combat.

entities.name: Riku of Two Reflections
entities.description: Mage who split himself into two reflections to master both spellcraft and life.

entities.name: Animar, Soul of Elements
entities.description: Folkloric ultimate source of all life on its plane.

entities.name: Edric, Spymaster of Trest
entities.description: Spymaster of the port city of Trest, over four centuries old.

entities.name: Ghave, Guru of Spores
entities.description: Mycoid hero who turned the tide against human invaders of the fungal forests of Drakkus.

entities.name: Karador, Ghost Chieftain
entities.description: Slain centaur warchief who haunts his birth valleys as a king of wraiths.

entities.name: Vish Kal, Blood Arbiter
entities.description: Ancient vampire who judges and executes the wicked by his own code.

entities.name: Zedruu the Greathearted
entities.description: Erlundi woman who sacrificed herself to break a plague curse.

entities.name: Ruhan of the Fomori
entities.description: Blind Fomori warrior who follows only his own whim.

entities.name: Nin, the Pain Artist
entities.description: Artist who explores the personal limits of her clients to awaken self-knowledge.

entities.name: The Mimeoplasm
entities.description: Entity that crawls Muraganda absorbing traits of what it engulfs.

entities.name: Damia, Sage of Stone
entities.description: Gorgon sage of vast magical knowledge whose statuary is littered with those who tried to force secrets from her.

entities.name: Skullbriar, the Walking Grave
entities.description: Undead elemental fused from a necromancer and an elementalist.

entities.name: Trest
entities.description: Port city where Edric's spy network operates.

entities.name: Kinnesta
entities.description: Land ruled by an empress who consults Edric.

entities.name: Drakkus
entities.description: Land devastated by monsoons, home of the war between humans and mycoids.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: World crawled by the Mimeoplasm.

entities.name: Mycoids
entities.description: Fungal people of Drakkus who declared war on the invading humans.

entities.name: Erlundi
entities.description: Zedruu's people, cursed by a plague.

entities.name: Fomori
entities.description: Warrior people who trained Ruhan.

events.summary: Shadowy beings massacre Kaalia's congregation; she survives with a fractured soul.
events.quote: Her once-simple life as a cleric was reduced to ashes when shadowy beings massacred her congregation.

events.summary: Riku splits himself into two reflections using an illusionist's spell.
events.quote: he secretly split himself into two reflections

events.summary: Monsoons devastate Drakkus and humans flee into fungal forests where the mycoids declare war on them.
events.quote: they declared war on the invading mammals

events.summary: Ghave emerges and turns the tide, sculpting an ever-mutating army and reclaiming his forest home.
events.quote: Ghave sculpted the fungal matter of his people into an ever-mutating army and reclaimed his forest home.

events.summary: Karador is slain in a great battle by a rival warchief who deposed him and now haunts as a ghost king.
events.quote: Karador was slain in a great battle.

events.summary: A plague curses the Erlundi and Zedruu offers her life, breaking the curse.
events.quote: she offered her life in exchange for her people's

events.summary: Skullbriar is formed when a necromancer and an elementalist fuse together in a grim pact.
events.quote: The undead monstrosity known as Skullbriar was formed when a necromancer and an elementalist entered into a grim pact.

relations.note: Ghave shaped the sporeborn into an army
relations.quote: Gifted with mystic influence over the sporeborn
In the port city of Trest, nothing escapes Edric's network of spies
He was trained by famed Fomori swordmasters
a plague cursed her Erlundi people
